source.rationale: C1. Without the `case 'offer_hold':` arm this switch has no matching case, falls through to the initialised defaults, and emits response '' / manualResponse false / includeResponse true / is_escalate_offer false on a branch that has already tagged itself branch_kind 'offer_hold' - a lie about the turn (manualResponse false means the clarification LLM is allowed to reshape a reply that must not change), rescued only by compile-current-state's Case B arm re-writing user_response afterwards. The arm's contract, derived before running the body: (1) response is pulled BY REFERENCE from offer-hold-reply (no LLM, no roster refetch) so it is byte-equal to clarify_text; (2) manualResponse true - the text is frozen; (3) includeResponse true - the customer must actually see it, unlike out_of_scope; (4) is_escalate_offer false so cs-offer-gate takes its FALSE edge straight to compile-current-state instead of refetching a CS roster for a pool that is already open.
